vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: persona-customer-support
Version: 1.0.10

The skill bundle defines a customer support persona designed to manage tickets and communications using Google Workspace tools (gws). The instructions in SKILL.md are consistent with the stated purpose, involving standard operations like triaging emails, logging data to spreadsheets, and scheduling calendar events, with no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only persona that orchestrates a Google-workspace-style CLI set (gws + related utility skills) and its declared requirements align with its stated customer-support purpose.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (customer support: triage, convert emails to tasks, log status, escalate, schedule calls) matches the SKILL.md instructions and the declared dependency on the 'gws' binary and related gws-* utility skills.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions only invoke gws workflows and gws subskills (gmail, sheets, chat, calendar) and reference support-related operations; there are no instructions to read arbitrary files, other env vars, or send data to unrelated endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files — the skill is instruction-only, which minimizes disk-write risk. The one runtime dependency is the 'gws' CLI which is expected for the described workflows.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill itself requests no env vars or credentials. However it requires other gws-* utility skills (gws-gmail, gws-sheets, gws-chat, gws-calendar) which will likely need Google/other service credentials; verify those utility skills request only appropriate service credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Default invocation settings are used (not always:true). The skill is a persona wrapper and does not request elevated/always-present privileges or modify other skills' configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and appears coherent for customer-support orchestration. Before installing, confirm: (1) the 'gws' CLI is a trusted tool and you know its origin, (2) the referenced utility skills (gws-gmail, gws-sheets, gws-chat, gws-calendar) are trusted and request only appropriate Google/workspace credentials, and (3) any OAuth/API tokens used by those utilities are scoped minimally. Because this skill delegates actions to other skills and the gws CLI, the safety depends on those components rather than this instruction file.
